chapters.title: To live is Christ
chapters.summary: Writing from prison, Paul thanks God for the Philippians and is sure He will complete the good work He began. His chains have spread the gospel. To live is Christ, and to die is gain.

chapters.title: The mind of Christ
chapters.summary: Be humble and look to others' interests. Christ emptied Himself, took the form of a servant and died on a cross, so God highly exalted Him and every knee shall bow.

chapters.title: Knowing Christ
chapters.summary: Paul counts all his past credentials as loss compared to knowing Christ. Forgetting what is behind, he presses on toward the prize.

chapters.title: Rejoice in the Lord
chapters.summary: Rejoice in the Lord always. Do not be anxious, but pray, and the peace of God will guard your hearts. I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
